typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	PNLinAvgPriceDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{DTD PL} as decimal(26,8),
		{MTD PL} as decimal(25,8),
		{YTD PL} as decimal(25,8),
		CUSIP as string,
		TYPE as string,
		BREAKTYPE as string,
		AGEDDAYS as integer,
		ACTUALDATE as timestamp,
		INVENTORY as string,
		QUANTITY as decimal(24,8),
		{MARKET VALUE} as decimal(24,8),
		TICKERSYMBOL as string,
		INSTRUMENTDESCRIPTION1 as string,
		PRODUCTTYPE1 as string,
		PRODUCTTYPE2 as string,
		DIVISIONDESCRIPTION as string,
		DISTRICTDESCRIPTION as string,
		SUBDISTRICT1DESCRIPTION as string,
		CUSTOMERDESCRIPTION1 as string,
		FAILTORECEIVEQUANTITYCURRENTAMT as decimal(24,8),
		FAILTODELIVERQUANTITYCURRENTAMT as decimal(24,8),
		AGINGCATEGORY as string,
		SOURCESYSTEMNAME as string,
		SOURCEPOSITIONID as string,
		UNREALIZEDGAINLOSSAMT as decimal(24,8),
		REALIZEDGAINLOSSAMT as decimal(24,8)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> PNLinAvgPriceSource
PNLinAvgPriceSource derive(ToAddLoaddate = currentTimestamp()) ~> ToAddLoadDate
ToAddLoadDate sink(input(
		SubDistrict1Description as string,
		ProductType2 as string,
		ProductType1 as string,
		FailToDeliverQuantityCurrentAmt as integer,
		Load_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ActualDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CUSIP as string,
		MarketValue as integer,
		SOURCESYSTEMNAME as string,
		AgedDays as integer,
		CustomerDescription1 as string,
		TickerSymbol as string,
		DistrictDescription as string,
		MTD_PL as integer,
		AGINGCATEGORY as string,
		FailToReceiveQuantityCurrentAmt as integer,
		SOURCEPOSITIONID as string,
		InstrumentDescription1 as string,
		BreakType as string,
		Quantity as integer,
		DivisionDescription as string,
		YTD_PL as integer,
		DTD_PL as integer,
		Type as string,
		Inventory as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		SubDistrict1Description = SUBDISTRICT1DESCRIPTION,
		ProductType2 = PRODUCTTYPE2,
		ProductType1 = PRODUCTTYPE1,
		FailToDeliverQuantityCurrentAmt = FAILTODELIVERQUANTITYCURRENTAMT,
		Load_Date = ToAddLoaddate,
		ActualDate = ACTUALDATE,
		CUSIP,
		MarketValue = {MARKET VALUE},
		SOURCESYSTEMNAME,
		AgedDays = AGEDDAYS,
		CustomerDescription1 = CUSTOMERDESCRIPTION1,
		TickerSymbol = TICKERSYMBOL,
		DistrictDescription = DISTRICTDESCRIPTION,
		MTD_PL = {MTD PL},
		AGINGCATEGORY,
		FailToReceiveQuantityCurrentAmt = FAILTORECEIVEQUANTITYCURRENTAMT,
		SOURCEPOSITIONID,
		InstrumentDescription1 = INSTRUMENTDESCRIPTION1,
		BreakType = BREAKTYPE,
		Quantity = QUANTITY,
		DivisionDescription = DIVISIONDESCRIPTION,
		YTD_PL = {YTD PL},
		DTD_PL = {DTD PL},
		Type = TYPE,
		Inventory = INVENTORY),
	partitionFileNames:[($PNLinAvgPriceDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> PNLinAvgPriceDestination
